name: routine-watch
description: Tells you when a scheduled routine (a scheduled-task run) stops to wait on you: a Mac notification, an optional phone push and a status line when it asks for permission or asks a question, plus a note when it finishes. Optionally lets routines read the web without asking. No model calls.

notifyMac.title: Mac notification when a routine waits
notifyMac.description: Post a macOS notification (osascript, with a sound) when a routine is waiting for your OK, asks you a question, stops on an error or finishes.

allowWebReads.title: Let routines read the web without asking
allowWebReads.description: In routine runs only, allow WebFetch and WebSearch instead of asking you. Nothing else is ever allowed, and a rule that denies still denies. Off by default because it loosens permissions.

notifyCommand.title: Phone push command
notifyCommand.description: Also run this command on the same events, e.g. curl -s -d {message} ntfy.sh/my-topic. It is split on spaces and {title} and {message} are filled into single arguments; no shell is involved. Empty: no push.

notifyOnFinish.title: Notify when a routine finishes
notifyOnFinish.description: When a routine's session ends, say how long it ran and how many times it waited on you.
